title: Big Tree RV Park
gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: Dogs are allowed to stay on our daily and weekly sites and must be approved by management. No aggressive breeds. Daily and weekly site rates are for 2 people. There will be an additional charge of $3 per person per day for more than two people. A maximum of 4 people may stay on a site. None of our sites include cable, phone or satellite. No tent camping allowed on any site within the park.
